running `workshop refresh` to re-run `setup-project`. It
recommends `--wait-on-error` for live debugging if the hook

a failure.
failed_assertions.reason: The response correctly says to edit the in-project hook in place and run `workshop refresh`, and it recommends `--wait-on-error` for live debugging. It also mentions `workshop changes` and `workshop tasks <ID>`, but frames them mainly as verification/confirming success rather than explicitly for inspecting hook stdout/stderr after a failure. Thus it only partially satisfies the rubric.
